brief: Report an experiment across 1,240 sessions. Conversion moved from 7.8% to 9.1%, with a 95% confidence interval of +0.2 to +2.4 percentage points. Recommend a two-week monitored rollout. The evidence URL is https://example.test/experiment-42.

Analyze the queue incident on 2026-07-14. Customer impact lasted 43 minutes and affected 6% of jobs. Estimated credits are USD 12,000. No personal data was exposed. The immediate action is adding saturation alerts by 2026-08-31.

Synthesize 18 interviews: 11 participants could not find audit history, 4 wanted exports, and 3 reported no material gap. Recommend audit-history navigation in Q4 within a USD 80,000 budget. Export automation is out of scope.
